name: SCM1616
summary: SCM1616 is a Sycsense capacitive sensor acquisition module for robotic and wearable sensing systems. It supports up to 256 sensor channels and UART, BT, WIFI communication. The SCM series integrates a capacitance acquisition chip, an M0 processor and LDO power regulation in a castellated SMT module.
